name: Systems check
author: Brett
description: The systems check and What's new banners at the top of every view. Checks come from reading the codebase (every plugin, the services it needs and its own declared self-checks, project manifests, shared data) plus the built-in credential, GitHub, Coolify, axHub and VPS checks. With the AI switch on (needs the AI assistant and Mosses), Mosses adds checks and saves them as a routine that runs without AI, and summarises what's new. Settings → Plugins → Systems check.
